segments.name: Self-Storage Operations
segments.description: Owns and operates self-storage facilities offering month-to-month storage space leases for personal and business use.
segments.evidence: The Self-Storage Operations reportable segment reflects the aggregated rental operations from the self-storage facilities we own through the following operating segments: (i) Same Store Facilities, (ii) Acquired Facilities, (iii) Newly Developed and Expanded Facilities, and (iv) Other Non-Same Store Facilities.

segments.name: Ancillary Operations
segments.description: Combines tenant reinsurance, merchandise sales, and third-party property management operations.
segments.evidence: Ancillary Operations reflects the combined operations of our tenant reinsurance, merchandise sales, and third party property management operating segments.

revenueModel.text: Customers pay monthly rent for storage space, optionally buy tenant insurance and merchandise, and third-party owners pay management fees.
revenueModel.evidence: We acquire, develop, own, and operate self-storage facilities, which offer storage spaces for lease on a month-to-month basis, for personal and business use.

changes.text: In 2024 the company implemented a bridge lending program providing financing to third-party self-storage owners.
changes.evidence: We implemented a lending program in 2024, under which we provide bridge lending financing to third-party self-storage owners for operating properties that we manage.
